block.printer.name: Block name
block.printer.host_hint: Uses equipment installed on the BloxSmith host, not on a remote browser’s computer.
block.printer.run_hint: Apply settings before Run. If a Run is already loaded, stop it and start it again to use the new settings.
block.printer.apply_hint: Changes remain local until you apply them.
block.printer.device_empty: No equipment found. Check the installation and permissions on the BloxSmith host.
block.printer.device_found: Equipment list updated. Select a device, then Apply.
block.printer.device_error: Unable to list equipment. Check the device tools on the BloxSmith host.
block.printer.flow_hint: Connect a File block, a PDF output, or text to document. Each execution creates a print job. job contains its CUPS ID, not physical completion status.
block.printer.limits_hint: PDF, plain text, PostScript and standard images are supported through installed CUPS filters. Convert Office files to PDF. No automatic retry; Stop cannot recall an already accepted print job.
block.printer.model.description: Prints incoming documents through an installed CUPS printer.
